excerpt: HireKey checks your fit for a tech role, tailors your resume, coaches interviews by voice and tracks applications. Free plan; Premium $39 a month.
content:
HireKey is an AI job-search tool for people applying to roles in tech. You add a job and your master resume, and it compares the two: which requirements your resume shows, which it misses, and whether the role is worth pursuing. It then rewrites your resume bullets for that job, showing each original line next to the tailored one so you approve every change; the site says tailoring should clarify real experience, not invent it. It also drafts cover letters and short company research briefs.

For interviews, HireKey generates recruiter-screen and hiring-manager questions from the job description and has a voice coach you answer out loud. The coach follows what you say, asks for more detail when your part in the work is unclear, and gives a debrief. On Product Hunt the co-founder said it uses the STAR structure, does not grade accent or pronunciation, and should not be treated as a check of technical accuracy. A job tracker with table and Kanban views keeps applications in stages from Not Applied to Offer.

HireKey was founded by Nela Davis, who says she spent 10 years in tech recruiting including at Microsoft, Amazon and Stripe, and Lance Davis Jr., who brings a background in sales. It launched on Product Hunt on 11 October 2026 and finished #1 for the day with 236 upvotes and 37 comments.

We have not tested HireKey ourselves. This page brings together HireKey's website, about and data-security pages, its Product Hunt launch and the official pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

paragraphs: Nela Davis says she spent 10 years recruiting for technical and non-technical roles and kept seeing qualified people passed over, either because their resume did not connect their experience to the role or because they struggled to explain it in an interview.

She and her co-founder built HireKey around that recruiting knowledge. The flow she described: add a job and your master resume, tailor the resume and see your gaps, practise answers out loud with the voice coach, and track each application by stage. She said a Chrome extension that captures job details automatically was coming for Premium users, and offered a free month of Premium to Product Hunt visitors at launch.

faq.a: An AI job-search tool for tech roles that checks your fit for a job, tailors your resume, drafts cover letters, coaches interview answers by voice and tracks your applications.
There is a free plan with monthly limits, such as 5 resume tailoring sessions and 2 voice coaching sessions, plus unlimited job tracking. Premium is $39 a month.

faq.q: Does the voice coach judge my English or accent?
faq.a: No. The co-founder said on Product Hunt that it gives feedback on the content and structure of your answer, not accent, pronunciation or fluency, and that you can also type answers.

faq.q: Does it check whether my technical answers are correct?
faq.a: It helps structure answers using STAR and points out where more detail is needed, but the co-founder said not to treat it as a definitive check of technical accuracy.

faq.q: Will it invent experience on my resume?
faq.a: HireKey says tailoring is meant to clarify real experience, not invent qualifications or results, and you review every change.

HireKey's data-security page says it uses Supabase, Railway and Vercel, OpenAI for AI features and Microsoft for coach voice playback. You can ask privacy@hirekey.io to delete your data, which it says happens within seven days.
Jobright AI, WonsultingAI, Teal and Resume Worded are other AI job-search and resume tools listed on Product Hunt.

alternatives.intro: These come from Product Hunt's alternatives list for HireKey. Prices come from each product's own pricing page, checked on 15 October 2026; review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Jobright AI
items.difference: Focuses on finding and matching jobs, autofilling applications and suggesting referral contacts, as well as tailoring resumes.

items.name: WonsultingAI
items.what: Your Job Search Suite, Powered by AI
items.difference: A cheaper Premium plan covering resume, cover letter, networking and interview prep tools, with full access to its InterviewAI.

items.name: Teal
items.what: Better Resume. Faster Search. More Offers.
items.difference: A broader career toolkit across resume building and job search; Product Hunt files it under job boards and professional networking too.

items.name: Resume Worded
items.what: Resume Worded is a searchable database of real resume lines.
items.difference: Centred on resume wording and scoring rather than interview practice or application tracking.
